The cause, replayed with Expo Go 57's own request headers: as `Expo-Updates-Environment: EXPO_DEVICE` EAS answers 403 "this project requires authentication. Sign in to Expo Go with an Expo account that is a member of the account that owns this project"; as `EXPO_SIMULATOR` it answers 200 with the certificate chain. Expo Go picks EXPO_DEVICE because redroid's build props pass its emulator check (expo-modules-core EmulatorUtilities). Signing in would not help on Android 57.0.9 either: its loader reads the session from the wrong preferences file (expo/expo#50253, fixed in #50498, not yet released). The device now boots with `ro.product.name=wf_redroid_emulator`, which that check reads; s0.json records `deviceProduct`.

- 2026-10-22 S1 read-back, cause found and fixed, not ticked: the forwarder and the CI bake were right, `wf vm logs` read the wrong half. BetterStack keeps only a source's newest rows in `<source>_logs` (read as `remote(...)`) and moves older ones to `<source>_s3` (`s3Cluster(primary, ...)` with `_row_type = 1`); `build_sql` read only the first. The quiet mobile source had 0 rows in its recent table and 1722 in the archive (12:47 to 20:03 UTC), so it always read empty; backend only looked healthy because it emits constantly, and even `--since 3d` returned just the 635 rows since the last archive step, of 45 497. Evidence, all read-only: the baked token is the token of the `Mobile Learning App` source (compared by sha256 prefix, nothing printed), `CH_MOBILE_TABLE` is that source's table, and its archive holds 9 `app.boot` rows, all `source=AppShell` on android: update 01a162c4 x3, 01a16437 x4 and 01a16509 x2, which match the CI Android jobs of runs 39833705842 and 39840374807. Fix: `vm_logs.rs` reads the union of both halves (`rows_source`, the filter in each half so both are pruned by `dt`; a table name without `_logs` reads alone) and waits up to 30 s (the archive costs 3 to 8 s); a mobile row's top-level `source` is now its module column, so `--module AppShell` matches. Test: `vm_logs_queries_betterstack_over_https_and_prints_one_line_per_row` in `clis/wf/tests/flow/vm.rs` pins the union for both sources, the grep and window in both halves, and one printed `app.boot` row; it fails with the archive half off. Read-back with the fixed wf: `wf vm logs --source mobile --since 2d --grep app.boot` prints those 9 rows; `--source backend --since 3d --limit 100000` prints 45 497.
